paragraphs: The S-Type 4.2 V8 uses the AJ-V8 — a 4.2-litre naturally aspirated V8 petrol engine. It was fitted to the X200-generation S-Type from its introduction in 1999 until the model was discontinued in 2008. The AJ-V8 was Jaguar's flagship engine of the era and is a completely different unit from the AJ-V6 found in the smaller-engined S-Type variants.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace engine engines for every S-Type 4.2 V8 on the road.

cards.body: A 4.2-litre naturally aspirated V8 petrol fitted to the S-Type from 1999 to 2008 (X200 generation). Known for timing chain stretch over time — see the callout above. We replace the timing chain, tensioners, guide rails, and gaskets as standard on every AJ-V8 rebuild. Check Your AJ-V8 S-Type 4.2 V8 → [link to quote form]

compatibility.intro: The S-Type 4.2 V8 uses the AJ-V8 engine across its entire production run. While there were no major engine code changes within the S-Type's lifecycle, ensuring the correct specification is still critical — particularly when it comes to ancillaries, electronics, and ECU matching.
